text:
olivia_csm: Need a single-page "pocket card" for customers going live. Focus: reduce cold starts, stabilize latency, and surface renewal-risk signals. Keep it copyable for AMs.
kevin_eng: happy to help. prefer a 6-line checklist + 3 quick config snippets. customers hate long docs.
jess_cs: +1. include one-liner we can paste into emails explaining priming.
olivia_csm: suggested structure: 1) Preflight (permissions, model pin, quota) 2) Prime (prefill, warm pools) 3) Runtime knobs (batching, cache TTL, streaming) 4) Watchlist (what telemetry to watch) 5) Escalation/renewal triggers 6) Post-priming feedback template.
sam_sre: add operational caveats: streaming helps UX but raises connection and on-host memory usage. include fallback: non-streaming route or smaller model.
kevin_eng: config snippet customers can give to infra team:
kevin_eng: ```yaml
# customer-suggested priming config
priming:
  enabled: true
  prefill_requests: 20
  warm_pool_instances: 2
serving:
  batch:
    max_requests: 6
    max_tokens: 512
  streaming: true
  cache:
    prefix_ttl_seconds: 600
```
jess_cs: email one-liner: "We'll run a short priming run to warm model instances and cache frequent prefixes so your first users see low latency during launch."
sam_sre: telemetry queries to paste into Console (golden prompts and health):
sam_sre: ```query
rate(errors{service="inference", tenant="${tenant}"}[5m])
avg(latency_ms{model="${model}"}[5m])
sliding_success_rate(prompt_set="golden", window=1h)
```
kevin_eng: suggested alert thresholds customers should agree to monitor: 1) errors > 3x baseline for 10m 2) golden prompt success rate drop >= 30% over 1h 3) avg latency >= 2x baseline for 15m. If any trigger -> page eng-oncall and tag ticket with onboarding:high-risk.
jess_cs: customer-facing checklist (copyable):
1) Confirm model pinned to exact version + quantization profile.
2) Ensure service account has inference:invoke + metrics:read.
3) Approve a 30min priming window.
4) Run priming job (we recommend 20 representative flows).
5) After priming, run 5 golden prompts and report latency + any unexpected outputs.
kevin_eng: mini troubleshooting steps (in order): 1) verify warm_pool_instances > 0 2) check prefill_requests completed 3) if tail latency high -> reduce batch.max_requests or increase inter-batch interval 4) if connection errors during streaming -> lower concurrent connections or toggle streaming=false 5) if quality regressions -> confirm model pin and revert to prior version.
sam_sre: automation hooks: example alert rule (pseudo):
if avg(latency_ms{tenant="${tenant}"}[5m]) > baseline*2 for 15m -> create ticket + notify #eng-oncall + run fallback(route:smaller-model).
opsbot: Created internal priming job template -> /ops/templates/launch-priming-job.yaml :white_check_mark:
jess_cs: post-priming survey (one-line email + 3 bullets to paste):
Subject: "Priming finished — quick check"
Body bullets: "1) Did outputs match expectations? (Yes/No) 2) Average observed latency (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts or surprising completions?"
olivia_csm: renewal-risk play: cadence + actions: 48h after launch do 1:1 health check; if metrics still outside thresholds after 72h escalate to Solutions Eng; if customer reports repeated quality issues -> recommend pause expansion and open remediation ticket.
kevin_eng: add note: batching/caching reduce cost, but for small-traffic customers prefer smaller batch sizes or no batching to keep per-request latency predictable.
jess_cs: final: give AM a 30s script to share with customer when requesting priming window: "We'd like 30 minutes to run short, representative traffic to warm model instances and cache common prefixes. This reduces initial latency for your users."
olivia_csm: I'll format this into a one-pager and post back. tagging @kevin_eng @sam_sre for final tech checks. ETA: tomorrow AM.
